incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired — high 5xx rate on /v1/embed (canary rollout) — severity: P1 — paging on-call: Carla (oncall) — incident link: https://pd.example/INC-98765

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-98765 triggered, escalation policy: infra-oncall. Paging Carla.

Carla (oncall): ack'd. I'm awake, looking. Where is traffic spike?

Alice (SRE): saw spike at 15:04 UTC, p99 latency up a bit but big thing is 5xx rate went from 0.1% -> ~3% in eu-west-1 canary pool. Metrics: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc/embed-5xx

Ben (eng-runtime): thanks Alice. This was the new quant-path kernel rollout (release 2026.03.14-c). Canary started at 15:00. Initial logs show segfaults in quant-kernel on some GPU types, fallback yields 502. Pushing raw logs to #tmp.

Carla (oncall): can we pause the rollout? If canary failing, pause and divert traffic to stable.

Ben (eng-runtime): issuing pause via deployctl now. `deployctl rollout pause 2026.03.14-c --env=canary-eu-west`

ben (eng-runtime): pause command returned success. Canary traffic halted at 15:07.

incident-bot: Canary rollout paused by ben (eng-runtime) — command: `deployctl rollout pause 2026.03.14-c` — status: paused.

Alice (SRE): starting immediate rollback plan: recommend rollback to previous variant `embed-v2-stable` on canary nodes, then scale up healthy pool while we investigate kernel. Will coordinate with Ben.

Ben (eng-runtime): starting rollback job: `deployctl rollback --target embed-v2-stable --env=canary-eu-west --force` — monitoring logs.

Dave (support): flagging support queue: several customers reported increased errors (EU region). Customer-impact channel: https://support/queues/incident/98765 — copying notes to ticket #SR-5543.

Carla (oncall): PagerDuty: acked. Escalations suppressed. I'm taking incident lead. Quick customer impact estimate?

Alice (SRE): from telemetry: total requests in eu-west canary pool 15:00-15:10 = ~120k, errors ~3.4k => 2.8% absolute, but canary traffic fraction was ~40% of eu-west traffic, so overall EU-region user-facing error rate bump ~1.1% for that interval. Affected customers: mainly embedding-heavy tenants on dedicated flows — support list incoming.

Eve (product): raising priority for any paying customers in that list. Dave please surface top-5 customers to me and CS.

Dave (support): noted — pulling top-5 now, will DM Eve and Carla.

ben (eng-runtime): rollback job completed at 15:10. Canary nodes back to `embed-v2-stable`. Validating.. running smoke calls.

Alice (SRE): smoke: 200 responses restored, 5xx rate back to baseline within 2 minutes. p99 latency stable.

incident-bot: Auto-check: 5xx rate (eu-west) returned to baseline at 15:12. Incident still open for postmortem and follow-ups.

Carla (oncall): good. Next steps: 1) keep incident open until RCA, 2) create an internal ticket for kernel compatibility testing against our GPU fleet, 3) coordinate with release owner to fix or revert quant-path changes, 4) customer comms draft.

Ben (eng-runtime): created ticket INFRA-2142 for kernel/quant regression and assigned to runtime-ml. Also tagged release owner @omar.

Ben (eng-runtime): initial hypothesis: quantization kernel introduced an edge-case on mixed-precision on A100 variant (driver 540.x) that didn't manifest in CI (smaller batches). Repro script added to ticket.

Alice (SRE): adding runbook note: for future, add automatic canary traffic ramp backoff on >0.5% 5xx over 1m. Current ramp policy was too aggressive.

Carla (oncall): agree. Create followup action item for release gating and ramp rules.

Eve (product): customer comms: we need a short statement about service disruption & mitigation. Draft: "We observed increased errors for embedding requests in our EU region during a canary rollout at 15:00 UTC. We paused the rollout and rolled back the canary by 15:10 UTC. Error rates returned to normal within minutes. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with affected customers." Thoughts?

Dave (support): fine. I'll queue that for CS review and send to top-5 customers now.

incident-bot: Created incident ticket INC-98765 in our tracking system and linked INFRA-2142.

Carla (oncall): timeline summary for incident channel: 15:00 canary start, 15:04 5xx spike detected, 15:05 PD alert fired, 15:06 PD paged Carla, 15:07 rollout paused, 15:08 rollback started, 15:10 rollback complete, 15:12 baseline restored. Total customer-impact window ~12 minutes.

Alice (SRE): adding telemetry snippet for postmortem: ```
- metric: embed_5xx_rate
- region: eu-west-1
- canary_fraction: 0.4
- peak_error_rate: 0.028
- duration: ~00:12:00
- affected_customers: listed in SR-5543
```

Ben (eng-runtime): I'll block further promotions of 2026.03.14-c until kernel fix or fallback path is validated in a dedicated hardware matrix.

Carla (oncall): handing off to Ben/Alice for RCA. I'm closing pager duty escalation but keeping the incident in open state for follow-up items. If anything regresses, page me again.

pagerduty: Incident INC-98765 acknowledged by Carla (oncall). No further escalation at this time.

Eve (product): thanks all. Please add postmortem owner and ETA for the RCA.

Ben (eng-runtime): postmortem owner: Ben. ETA for initial RCA write-up: EOD today.

Carla (oncall): closing thread for urgent ops. Retain incident logs and assign actions in INFRA-2142. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-98765 status: mitigated — follow-ups assigned.
